name: The Glint-Sleeves
description: An inventor society that builds wearable artifice that fits over arms and hands.

timeline.summary: Ajani wears mechanical gauntlets made for him by Glint-Sleeves at Grandmother Pashiri's request while infiltrating Ghirapur.
timeline.quote: They'd been crafted by the Glint-Sleeves, a group that specialized in such bodily attachments.

pages_say.description: A group that crafts bodily attachments such as Ajani's gauntlets.
An inventor society that builds wearable artifice that fits over arms and hands.
